item.title: US task force to cut off Iran’s transport of advanced weapons: What we know
item.description: As fears of an escalation grow, Washington announces 'Task Force Iron Gate'.

item.title: Poland mourns six killed in attack as authorities launch ‘terrorism’ probe
item.description: 'Terrorism' investigation launched after government officials say suspect likely influenced by far-right ideology.

item.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine leave hundreds of thousands without electricity
item.description: About 850,000 people lose power after Russian attacks on energy infrastructure in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv.

item.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
item.description: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.

item.title: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike
item.description: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.

item.title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
item.description: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.

item.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
item.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

item.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
item.description: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.
